Summary: The payments service is panicking during POST /charge due to an attempt to assign to a nil map.
Possible Cause: The error message suggests that the code attempts to assign a value to a map that has not been initialized, which may be caused by a missing initialization step in the request handler or a race condition where the map is nil at the time of assignment.
Recommended Actions:
- Verify that all map variables used in the POST /charge handler are initialized before use, e.g., using make(map[KeyType]ValueType).
- Add defensive checks to ensure the map is not nil before assignment, and log a clear error if it is.
- Review recent code changes or deployments that modify the charge handler to identify any omitted initialization.
- Implement unit tests that cover map initialization scenarios to catch similar bugs early.
- Monitor the service after deployment to confirm the panic no longer occurs.
topMessages: panic serving POST /charge: assignment to entry in nil map
